label: Square Jeans Pocket
note: Owner-uploaded reference images. Authoritative for construction/appearance; NOT usable as the tech-pack illustration (not line art, or shows multiple options).

references.evidence: 149x234 px photograph of dark indigo DENIM jeans on a body, front hip, lit hard from the right with heavy shadow at frame left. Visible: waistband with magenta/pink contrast topstitching, one belt loop, metal rivets, a small rectangular coin pocket carrying two rivets and a brand tab, and the main front pocket opening topstitched in the same pink thread. Magnified, that opening reads as an L-shaped jeans pocket - a steep front edge that turns a corner and runs back toward the side seam - but the corner is softened/radiused rather than the crisp 90 degrees the label demands.
references.ownerNotes: perfect except there should be a square right angle at the front of the pocket. remember to keep a luxury wool fabric. preferably a navy blue pinstripe. the image is blue jeans and only for pocket shape reference
